help.start: Open HTML, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, CSV or project JSON. Edit text in the center and page settings in the inspector. Preview measures real browser geometry. Return to Edit to change content.
help.layout: The embedded 24→12→1 neural ranker compares up to 24 measured source-layout adjustments offline. Training uses original synthetic documents and engineering labels, not human aesthetic ratings. Independent gates check text preservation, image decoding and overflow. Inspect the pages. Only severe source-layout defects that cannot be repaired permit a ranked fallback among 24 templates; templates never add facts.
help.formats: DOCX is native OOXML with paragraphs, basic styling, tables, images, validated static SVG plus PNG fallback, paper size, columns, headers and footers. Vector figures remain whole images, not editable Word shapes. Complex CSS, formulas, footnotes, revisions, charts, nested or vertically merged tables and floating objects may simplify. ODT exports text and tables without images. RTF exports Unicode text paragraphs. Markdown is simplified. PDF uses browser printing; inspect paper size and fonts. Oversized table rows need manual splitting.
help.privacy: The English interface follows navigator.languages / navigator.language when supported. Sixteen embedded languages, manual override and English fallback work offline. Browser preferences may differ from the OS language; unsupported languages use English. Changing UI language never translates document content. No CDN, telemetry, external scripts or fonts are loaded. Save project JSON; browser storage may be blocked or cleared. Modern browsers are required; DOCX compressed import needs DecompressionStream. Printing and installed fonts vary across systems. Imported file instructions are never executed.
